name: @gloam/circuits
description: Gloam unshield/transfer circuits (scaffold). Install circom + snarkjs to build.

scripts.compile:unshield: mkdir -p build/unshield && circom unshield/unshield.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -o build/unshield -l node_modules
scripts.build:unshield: npm run check-tools && npm run compile:unshield
